title: Apps Reorganize the Entrance, and Agents Move toward Real Delivery
description: Five top stories and six briefs follow video-app consolidation, personal assistants, retrieval, advertising disclosure, and agent training. Two developer notes and one related paper keep their original dates.

jimeng-consolidation.verification_scope: Original report; organizational and product claims are attributed to the article, not to a ByteDance announcement

today-personal.verification_scope: Team interview; product path as stated by the team, not a generally verified effect

ballot-retrieval.verification_scope: TechCrunch report and the study page's model names, API, and search setting; not voting advice

pa-ad-labels.verification_scope: Signing report and the linked legislative text; not an inference that every provision has already taken effect

thinkingbox-training.verification_scope: Joint article's training setup and reported rates; 48-hour catch-up, not an independent reproduction

meta-sundial.verification_scope: Verge item relaying Axios; deal amount not adopted and full product integration not claimed

messaging-agents.verification_scope: Product catalog; not a claim that every product launched that day and not a performance ranking

product-retrospective.verification_scope: Retrospective list; earlier events are not rewritten as failures from this day

performing-productivity.verification_scope: Workplace interviews; unverified survey percentages are not adopted

battledrones-four.verification_scope: Project iteration note; not a general drone-control claim or a multiplayer benchmark

quick-study.verification_scope: Author's programming note; 48-hour catch-up, not a new image-generation model

jan-agent-payments.verification_scope: Visible excerpts on the published page; automatic captions, original video and translation check still pending; full talk not reviewed

paper-novice-reliance-review.verification_scope: Paper methods, results, and limits; not a new paper from this window and not proof about today's assistants
